checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Building recognizable as Biltmore House (pale stone French Renaissance, steep slate roof)
must.why: Pale stone chateau with slate roof, but it is a generic fairy-tale castle with conical turrets and symmetrical layout, not Biltmore's real facade.

must.item: Location and date appear exactly as requested and remain readable
must.why: No text appears in any frame.

must.item: No modern cars, clothing, string lights, or signage
must.why: None visible; only the house, lawn, pool and mountains.

must.item: English narration identifies opening to family and friends
must.why: The assistant's stated script says nothing about the family-and-friends opening; it describes the house and its 1895 build.

faults.what: The building is a generic fairy-tale chateau with turrets, not the real Biltmore House.
All required on-screen text is missing: title, location, date and the reconstruction label.
The narration script does not mention the family-and-friends opening on Christmas Eve 1895.
Shows autumn foliage and a reflecting pool that do not match Biltmore. The scene is not set on a December 24 date.
The drone push-in is smooth, but the building looks like an AI render.

summary: The video is a clean, attractive drone push-in on a generic AI chateau, but it is not recognizably Biltmore. It has no on-screen text at all, and the narration omits the family-and-friends opening.
